messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By which date must the Commission submit the second report on the evaluation and review of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 provided for in Article 53(1)?

response.text: In quale data la Commissione deve presentare la seconda relazione sulla valutazione e sul riesame del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 prevista dall'articolo 53, paragrafo 1?
